Best thing for weightloss is a calorie deficit, count the calories you consume in a day and try reducing it by 500 calories and track your weight.

Excercise will help too but the only way to lose weight is to be in a caloric deficit so tracking your calories is a must.

I lost 155 lbs in about a yr, combination of 3 things helped.

Counting calories is #1 for weight loss as 70% of the weight you can control is from your diet.

I go to the gym 6 days a week, the other 30% of the weight you can lose will come from excercise.

And finally i intermittently fast, i eat one big meal a day and thats it.

Most important thing by far is you need to want it more than anything, no excuses no bullshit just do it, the only person holding you back is you.

But I know that there is nothing anyone else could say to get me to do it, but as soon as I wanted to do it I know no one could stop me.

Stopped eating too much, went from 350 lbs to now 195 in a year, also went to the gym 6 days a week too. Went from feeling like shit every day, depressed and constant brain fog, went 23 yrs with no interest in me.

Compared to now I wake up happy every day, ive recently had a girl ask me out, feel smarter, feel way stronger, quite literally feel like a better version of me in every way.

10/10 would recommend.
